note: Rewritten from the original description of the new species by Light & Wilson (1936) (Nasutitermes taylori sp. nov.); the original is in English. The text window begins in the middle of the alate description, so the preceding matter on head colour, wing venation and the like is not included and only the ocellus/compound-eye passage and the measurement table are recorded for the alate; the soldier section and the Remarks are complete. The original term Head production is reproduced as such; Antenne is an OCR loss for antenna; the measurements are in millimetres as stated in the table heading. The subdivisions of Fig. 20 (a, alate head in dorsal view; b, d, soldier head in dorsal view; c, e, soldier head in lateral view; f, soldier left mandible) are not transcribed.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The long diameter of the ocellus is about twice the short diameter; the long diameter is about half the diameter of the compound eye; the distance from the compound eye is about equal to the long diameter of the ocellus. Compound eyes small, projecting; separated from the lower margin of the head by about one third of their own diameter, from the upper margin by more than half their own diameter, and from the posterior margin of the head by more than their own diameter. Measurements (mm): total length 13.06; forewing length 11.04; forewing width 2.94; head length 1.51; head-capsule length 1.05; head-capsule width 1.08; head width including compound eyes 1.33; pronotum length 0.69; pronotum width 1.12; compound-eye diameter 0.36; ocellus long diameter 0.14; ocellus short diameter 0.12; ocellus-compound eye distance 0.09. Measurements from a typical alate of the type series (No. 1158, Cotabato, Mindanao).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale fuscous yellowish brown, paler posteriorly; rostrum red, darker at the base; nota brown, strongly chitinized. Shape of head and rostrum as in Fig. 20 b—e; rostrum long, rostral tubercle prominent; constriction distinct; fine white hairs scattered over the head. Antennae 12 or 13-segmented; when 13-segmented, segments II and IV the shortest and segment III twice as long as segment IV. Measurements and indices (mm): head with rostrum 1.62; head length (excluding rostrum) 0.96; rostrum length 0.66; head production 0.33; head height 0.62; head width 0.91; foretibia length 0.84; head index 0.95; head-rostrum index 0.69; head-production index 0.34; leg-extension index 0.88. Measurements from a typical soldier of collection 1158.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type collection No. 1158, from Cotabato, Mindanao. Both series of this species were collected by Taylor: one on Tatayan Island off the coast of Cotabato, Mindanao, the other at Caldera near Cotabato; the series taken early in April (month 4) contains many fully coloured alates. The soldier resembles N. castaneus in appearance, but the head is larger and the rostrum relatively shorter, the head-rostrum index being less than 0.70, whereas in N. castaneus it is more than 0.75; the pronotum is also less strongly chitinized than in N. castaneus.
